story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price PAYTM to move about ±9.0%, roughly 1,591 to 1,904. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 52% of the time.
PAYTM has actually been moving about 3.15% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.
PAYTM futures trade 5.2 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 3.4% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
Options are cheap compared with how much PAYTM has actually been moving: they price 38.1% a year while the last month realised 50.1%.

Near-term PAYTM options carry an extra premium: the expiry to 2026-12-29 prices one day worth about ±6.0%, against 1.72% normally. No scheduled event in the data explains it: the market is paying for near-term risk.

iv.simple: Options on PAYTM are priced for moves of about 2.40% a day. That is normal for PAYTM compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 38.1%: 66th percentile of 1 year, 49th of all days since 2024-11-29.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much PAYTM has actually been moving: they price 38.1% a year while the last month realised 50.1%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -12.0 vol points, 16th percentile of the past year. Since 2024-11-29, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 52% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Near-term options on PAYTM are pricier than longer ones. The market expects something soon: an event, or stress that it thinks will pass.
term.analyst: Term structure: 32d 38.1% -> 59d 35.8% (-2.3 vol pts). Front-expiry variance above the forward curve, expressed as one day: about ±6.0% against 1.72% on a normal day (forward vol 32.8%); no scheduled event in the data explains it.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.4 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Against the past year, that gap is normal for PAYTM.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.41 vol pts (front month), 66th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: PAYTM has actually been moving about 3.15% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 50.1% (92nd percentile of the past year), RV5 27.3%, RV63 43.7%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 24th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 2,000 (+14.8% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 1,700 (-2.4%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.75; all-expiry OI PCR at the 59th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls -355,975, puts -99,325 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: PAYTM futures trade 5.2 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 3.4% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +5.2, annualised carry 3.4% (13th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.2%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Short build-up, Long unwinding, Short covering, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price PAYTM to move about ±9.0%, roughly 1,591 to 1,904. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 52% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 8.95% (forward 1,747.2). Scored on 491 days since 2024-11-29 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: PAYTM has used 16% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
Lot size changes from 725 to 325 for the 2027-01-25 contracts (the exchange has already listed them so).
